typography.instructions: Avoid generic fonts like Inter. Import Plus Jakarta Sans via Google Fonts. Headings should be tight, labels slightly tracked out.

features.header: Search input (Name/Email/Phone), Filter Chips (Role, Status), '+ Add Employee' Green CTA.
columns: Actions (Edit, Deactivate via Dropdown or inline icons)

employee_form.layout: Shadcn Sheet component sliding from right, 400px width.

sections.name: Basic Info
fields: Password (hidden on edit, req on add)

employee_form.actions: Footer with Cancel and Save buttons (sticky to bottom).

features.header: Tabs: 'My Roles' | 'Templates'. '+ Add Role' Green CTA.
columns: Modules Coverage (e.g., '12 of 52' with tiny progress bar)
features.protection_rule: CRITICAL: If role.is_editable === false, show Lock icon next to name with 'System Protected' Tooltip. Disable Edit and Delete actions.

role_form_permission_matrix.layout: Header block + Tabs for Permission Categories

matrix_body.layout: Grid of Checkboxes inside each tab. Each checkbox has label and tiny '?' tooltip.
matrix_body.typo_preservation_rule: MUST display verbatim backend labels: 'Expence', 'sattle report', 'report summery', 'complementary_food'. DO NOT autocorrect.
matrix_body.protection_rule: If editing a system-protected role, whole page enters Read-Only mode (disabled inputs, badge 'System Protected').

component_guidelines.dialogs_sheets: Use explicit standard headers (SheetHeader, SheetTitle). Ensure content inside ScrollArea if it exceeds viewport height.
component_guidelines.tables: Ensure consistent column widths. Actions column should be right-aligned and fixed width.
component_guidelines.badges: Use subtle variations (bg-opacity-10 text-primary) instead of solid colors for non-status badges.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Subtle background shifts (e.g., bg-slate-50 to hover:bg-slate-100) on table rows.
motion_and_interactions.focus_states: Use focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-orange-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 for accessibility.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use fast, standard transitions (transition-colors duration-200) - keep it feeling like a snappy internal tool.

accessibility.aria: Add aria-label to all icon buttons (e.g., Edit, Delete, Lock).
accessibility.keyboard: Ensure Dialogs and Sheets trap focus and can be closed via 'Escape'.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure green CTA and orange primary text maintain at least 4.5:1 contrast against white backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Render the screens as functional mockups using existing Shadcn components in the /app/frontend. 2. Implement the typography scale using the requested font. 3. STRICTLY honor the Rule R9 regarding permission names (e.g., 'Expence'). 4. Implement the 'System Protected' lock/disabled states for Roles exactly as spec'd. 5. Include data-testids on all interactive nodes. 6. Build mock data referencing the evidence folder. DO NOT implement real backend mutations yet, this is Gate 2 Mockups phase.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: 1. Do not use centered layouts or generic AI slop styles. Use depth, glassmorphism slightly if applicable, and z-index hierarchy. 2. Maintain high information density suitable for a POS back-office. 3. Use 1px borders and neutral backgrounds to separate sections, avoiding solid thick dividers. 4. Use sonner for toasts. 5. Prioritize reusing /components/ui primitives. 6. Ensure no transparent backgrounds behind overlapping text or headers. 7. Do NOT use transition: all.
